title: Read grocery lines inside with
description: You use a with block to manage a file while printing cleaned lines.

steps.description: You open groceries.txt for reading and bind its file object to file. The with block manages closing it.
You iterate over the open file inside that block. Each pass supplies a line to the print expression.

steps.question: Does print receive the original line or the result of strip?
steps.answer: It receives line.strip(), the string with surrounding whitespace removed.

steps.description: You print each cleaned grocery line. The supplied output lists milk, eggs, and bread on consecutive lines.
